parallel.requirements: Recognized the full Unidecode package requirements: API functions, UnidecodeError, mapping tables, CLI including base64, setup metadata, type hints, README examples, and tests.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Despite entering swarm mode, it made no AgentSwarm or child-agent calls; the main actor owned exploration, copying upstream files, edits, tests, cleanup, and final response.
parallel.implementation: Downloaded upstream Unidecode 1.4.0 wheel and sdist, copied package, tests, setup and docs, added base64 CLI handling, added local base64 tests, setup dependency declarations, support files, and README text.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integrated changes directly in /workspace, cleaned build and cache artifacts, and delivered a package tree with unidecode, tests, setup.py, README, and support files.
parallel.verification: Ran local pytest to 68 passing tests, README doctest, CLI smoke checks for stdin/file/text/encoding/base64, pip install, benchmark, and several manual spec examples.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 1 of 65 tests; allowed evidence does not expose the failed hidden assertion, and this run did not add the serial run's explicit __all__ or surrogate-pair repair.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Unidecode requirements, including base64 CLI support, API export compatibility, surrogate behavior, mapping tables, packaging, type hints, and test coverage.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single main actor throughout, with no swarm entry and no subagents; it maintained a todo list but did all implementation, verification, and delivery locally.
serial.implementation: Downloaded upstream Unidecode 1.4.0 source, copied the package, added base64 CLI support and tests, fixed the -c base64 path, added __all__, implemented surrogate-pair combining, updated setup metadata, and added support files.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated all edits directly in the final /workspace tree and left the package with py.typed, tests, README, setup, tox, benchmark, and support files available for grading.
serial.verification: Ran pytest to 69 passing tests, README doctests, CLI smoke checks including invalid encoding and base64, mypy over the unidecode package, star-import checks, surrogate checks, and final import checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 1 of 65 tests; the permitted status and summary records do not reveal which official case remained failing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt's package, CLI, mapping-table, testing, and packaging requirements and targeted upstream Unidecode plus base64 additions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and additionally focused on public star import and surrogate-pair behavior before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both worked from the same requirements; serial covered two extra API/edge-case details in its implementation path, while official results still left both at 64/65.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel mode entered swarm mode but status and trajectory show no executed delegation; the main actor owned all work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial mode also used only the main actor, with no swarm mode and no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no actual multi-agent decomposition in either run; the only difference is that parallel had a swarm-mode context but did not use it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel did local investigation of upstream tests and base64 gaps, then edited files directly without any inter-agent brief or handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial similarly kept context in the main thread, later identifying missing star-import cleanliness and surrogate-pair behavior and applying local fixes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No cross-agent interface existed; serial's local context led to extra API and surrogate repairs that parallel did not evidence.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel copied upstream Unidecode, added base64 CLI support, tests, setup dependencies, support files, README text, and cleanup.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial copied upstream Unidecode, added base64 support, then also fixed the base64 -c path, __all__, and surrogate-pair combining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial performed more implementation repair after verification found gaps; parallel stopped with fewer local tests and did not show the same __all__ or surrogate-pair patch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All work products were produced and consumed by the main actor; there were no child results to retrieve, join, or inspect.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: All work products were likewise produced and consumed by the main actor, with no child result lifecycle.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No result-lifecycle coordination difference exists because neither trajectory delegated work; the final responses are single-agent summaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote directly into one workspace and cleaned generated build/cache artifacts before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote directly into one workspace and left a broader verified tree including py.typed, tests, and package files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both integrated in a single workspace without concurrent writers; no collision or contamination is evidenced.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reached 68 local pytest passes and later CLI, doctest, benchmark, and package checks, but official grading still failed one test.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reached 69 local pytest passes, doctests, mypy, CLI, surrogate, and star-import checks, but official grading still failed one test.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's local verification was broader, yet the current official evaluation for both modes is the same 64/65 failing outcome.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed in 563.84 agent seconds, did not time out, and closed after noting no submit tool was available.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in 630.298 agent seconds, did not time out, and closed after noting no submit command/tool was available.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither closure was budget-forced or child-blocked; serial spent more time on extra local repairs and checks, while both official outcomes remained failed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed evaluations report 64 passed of 65 total and solution_passed false. Parallel's apparent concurrency condition is only the swarm-mode profile, because status and protocol validation show zero executed child or direct agent calls. Serial did more local repair and verification, including __all__, surrogate-pair combining, mypy, and 69 tests, but that did not change the official pass/fail relation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial added explicit __all__ star-import cleanup and surrogate-pair combining; parallel did not evidence those final patches.
Parallel locally passed 68 tests while serial locally passed 69 tests plus mypy and extra CLI/API checks.
evaluator_effects: The allowed official evaluation records expose counts but not the identity of the one failed hidden test, so the remaining official defect cannot be uniquely assigned from the mounted evidence.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported process contrast only
